description: Define the numerical value and mathematical concept of zero, including its origins and historical development
Investigate the role of zero in different number systems, including binary, decimal, and other bases
Examine the impact of zero on various fields, such as physics, engineering, and computer science, including its representation and usage
Analyze the challenges and limitations associated with zero, including division by zero, zero-point energy, and other mathematical and physical paradoxes
Explore the cultural and philosophical significance of zero, including its symbolism, representation, and perception across different societies and historical periods
